entries.7120edafc353d8bd: VARs (value-added reseller partners) that add value to the company's products and resell them
entries.8ae6e5a9f8170ecc: This business covers the planning, design, manufacture, and operation and maintenance support of IoT-based products and solutions in a vertically integrated manner, flexibly providing the products customers want. It handles set-top boxes (STB), the wearable device 'Cygnus2', cordless call chimes and others, and expands its sales channels in collaboration with VARs (value-added reseller partners) that add value to products and resell them. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥219 million.
entries.b7645f546b11fa46: A company that designs and develops IoT devices in-house and provides object-originated SaaS services, made-to-order product development, and contract system development.
entries.c8709e09bebd19d5: Location owners such as mobile carrier shops and distribution and retail stores
entries.d960c0c486acffc2: This business provides IoT solutions that maximize customer value, selects optimal products, and provides SaaS services centered on those products, targeting the BtoB market. It operates the AI power reduction solution service 'AIrux8', the DX product for distribution and retail stores 'Tenpo no Hoshi', and the LED signage and signage distribution platform 'CELDIS'. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥143 million.
entries.efb88e4e73913cba: This business provides contract development of application software such as core business systems, provision and maintenance of PCs and servers needed for system operation, and engineer dispatch services for maintenance and resident maintenance of developed software and systems. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥123 million.
